about_the_game:
Gameplay

This is an auto chess game that combines slot machine gameplay. It is divided into multiple levels for challenges. Before each level battle, items will be drawn from the backpack to the slot machine. On the slot machine, the attributes of the items will be mutually enhanced based on their positions. Then, after entering the battle, charge the items. Once fully charged, launch the magic missile.

Game features

  • Rich growth strategies, items drawn before battles can mutually enhance attributes based on their positions. Different props can have very rich cultivation influences depending on their positions. Two identical items can also be combined into advanced items. Props can also be affected by the effects of prop sets, enchantments, etc. It enables you to gradually build powerful equipment sets.

  • The diversity of battles allows different combat items to interact with each other, creating completely different combat effects. Effective combinations can cause astonishing combat damage. The choice of combat items by players has a significant impact on the outcome of battles.

  • Rich randomness, levels and battle rewards are randomly generated, pre-battle items are randomly drawn, and the positions of the items are also randomly placed. Let every trip you play have a different experience

Story background

Lovecraftian story system. It tells the story of a group of believers who sold their souls and, if they gradually complete the game of the evil god in the abyss and achieve self-redemption
